q1_repeat_categories.answer: Users repeatedly buy from the same categories due to convenience, reliability, and regular needs, as seen in the 'Groceries & Staples' category where users mention ordering regularly and having great experiences.

q2_exploration_blockers.answer: Users are prevented from exploring new categories due to issues like high prices, poor product quality, and lack of availability, as well as frustrations with delivery and customer support, which can lead to a negative overall experience.

q3_discovery_channels.answer: Users discover products through search and word of mouth, as seen in quotes where users mention finding products they couldn't find in shops or recommending the app to friends.

q4_habit_role.answer: Habits play a significant role in shopping behavior, with users often relying on the app for regular and urgent needs, and some even mentioning that they are faithful customers who will continue to use the service.

q5_info_needed.answer: Users need information about product quality, availability, and pricing before trying a new category, as well as reliable customer support and a smooth delivery experience.

q6_recurring_frustrations.answer: Recurring frustrations include issues with delivery, product quality, and customer support, as well as high prices and lack of availability, which can lead to a negative overall experience and prevent users from exploring new categories.

q7_experimenting_segments.answer: The 'explorer' segment is more likely to experiment with new categories and products, as they are more open to trying new things and are less likely to be deterred by issues with delivery or product quality.

q8_unmet_needs.answer: Unmet needs include better product quality, more reliable customer support, and a smoother delivery experience, as well as more affordable pricing and a wider range of products, which can help to improve the overall user experience and increase customer satisfaction.
